scope: Diagnostic XNU entry probe with BCM-only MMIO suppressed and early exception display; no device action
success_requires: PROBE22: power-key Enter; yellow entry / magenta context checkpoints / blue call / green continuation. Grid uses 24-pixel row pitch. A02A=mismatched pixels of the white/cyan band at y224, A02B=last checking stage, A02C=1 native vectors restored (2=rejected). CPU readback is not physical scanout proof. Image4 native initializer RET is modeled only; ID89 is MAC continuation, ID6 is BSD entry, ID7/8 are root discovery/mount entry. Non-Apple host-measured launch inputs; no hardware replay protection or Apple trusted-boot claim. IDs178/179=before/after native OSKext load; ID180=function table non-NULL; ID181=already registered. Loader lifecycle and initializer body require physical observation. IDs182..211 trace native root calls and continuations. 184/185=IOBSD resource wait, 200/201=root matching wait. Blue without green is reachability only; wait implementation and IRQ/timer require separate evidence. Real APFS on RAMDisk, rd=md0. A035=actual native vfs_mountroot return, ID212 green=zero return, ID213 red=error; deliberate halt before restore userspace. Enlarged transport is not yet nuwa-qualified.
